source_policy: Project-derived original simulations. Historical sources provide task boundaries, not verified external-license or training claims.
global_constraint_rule_en: D22 text remains an exact contiguous substring. Noncontiguous shared constraints need not be copied into every span; D23 always receives the FULL original prompt in addition to the selected span, assigned domain and available prior results. Never turn a shared constraint into a new requested action.
semantic_checks_en: Every D22 text occurs verbatim in the original prompt. Check coverage of actions separately from constraint propagation.
Dependencies refer only to existing required predecessors; chronological text order alone creates no dependency.
The assigned domain in D23 matches the selected segment. Null-domain segments must be clarified before compilation.
D23 must retain all applicable global and local constraints, including negation and requested answer language.
Missing prior output produces task=null and a concrete missing entry. A worker does not fabricate a predecessor result.
The structured reference can provide an expected prior output for teaching, but it remains explicitly NOT_OBSERVED.
Each subject answer is an expected teaching target, not evidence that a tool, native route or training cycle ran.

family_policy.descendant_rule: Carry this origin through segmentation, compilation, code/documentation and translation derivatives; relabeling does not create an independent family.
